name: Football Analysis Short

delivery_notes: mark names and clubs for pronunciation

primary_visuals: licensed or user-provided match footage when available
visual_language.motion: fast but readable; arrows and zones land before the tactical point
visual_language.typography: bold sports sans with team/accent color discipline
visual_language.captions: clear lower-third or mid-screen chunks that avoid the ball/action
visual_language.color: green pitch base, white lines, one team color plus one neutral

preferred_sources: stock crowd/training footage only when it does not imply match evidence
asset_strategy.generated_visual_policy: Use generated diagrams freely; do not fake real match footage.

sound.music: sports momentum bed that does not overpower analysis
sound.sfx: whistle, tick, marker draw, stat pop, crowd swell only where licensed
sound.mix_rule: voiceover and tactical names stay clear

qc: rights for match footage are clear or footage is omitted
arrows/zones do not hide the ball, player, or key space
analysis language separates fact from opinion
